programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.desc: Judy McCarthy hopes for a fresh start in Texas, but a shadowy presence emerges in their home. It fixates on her teenage daughter, Caressa, tormenting her each night. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: A Haunting

Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: A Haunting

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.
